items.text: Once upon a time. <break time="0.8s" /> There was a king. <break time="0.8s" /> You may say. <break time="0.8s" /> But you are wrong. <break time="0.8s" /> Once upon a time. <break time="0.8s" /> There was only. <break time="0.8s" /> A simple piece of wood. <break time="0.8s" /> It was not expensive wood. <break time="0.8s" /> But a common log. <break time="0.8s" /> That people burned in winter. <break time="0.8s" /> One day this log came. <break time="0.8s" /> To the shop of an old carpenter. <break time="0.8s" /> Named Master Antonio. <break time="0.8s" /> Everyone called him Master Cherry. <break time="0.8s" /> Because his nose was red and shiny. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a ripe cherry. <break time="0.8s" /> When he saw the log. <break time="0.8s" /> He was very happy. <break time="0.8s" /> And rubbed his hands together. <break time="0.8s" /> I will make a leg. <break time="0.8s" /> For my little table. <break time="0.8s" /> With this he said. <break time="0.8s" /> He picked up his sharp axe. <break time="0.8s" /> But just then. <break time="0.8s" /> He heard a tiny voice. <break time="0.8s" /> Please do not hit me. <break time="0.8s" /> So hard. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried the voice. <break time="0.8s" /> Master Cherry looked all around the room. <break time="0.8s" /> But he found nobody there. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he began to smooth the log. <break time="0.8s" /> And the voice laughed. <break time="0.8s" /> Stop, you are tickling me. <break time="0.8s" /> The poor old man fell down. <break time="0.8s" /> In fright. <break time="0.8s" /> And his red nose turned blue.

Once upon a time there was a king, you may say, but you are wrong. <break time="0.8s" /> Once upon a time there was only a simple piece of wood. <break time="0.8s" /> It was not expensive wood, but a common log that people burned in winter. <break time="0.8s" /> One day this log came to the shop of an old carpenter named Master Antonio. <break time="0.8s" /> Everyone called him Master Cherry because his nose was red and shiny like a ripe cherry. <break time="0.8s" /> When he saw the log, he was very happy and rubbed his hands together. <break time="0.8s" /> I will make a leg for my little table with this, he said. <break time="0.8s" /> He picked up his sharp axe, but just then he heard a tiny voice. <break time="0.8s" /> Please do not hit me so hard, cried the voice. <break time="0.8s" /> Master Cherry looked all around the room, but he found nobody there. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he began to smooth the log, and the voice laughed, Stop, you are tickling me. <break time="0.8s" /> The poor old man fell down in fright, and his red nose turned blue.

옛날 옛적에. <break time="0.8s" /> 임금님이 있었어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 여러분은 이렇게 말할지도 몰라요. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 틀렸어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 옛날 옛적에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그저 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 평범한 나무토막 하나가. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 비싼 나무가 아니었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그저 흔한 통나무. <break time="0.8s" /> 사람들이 겨울에 때는. <break time="0.8s" /> 어느 날 이 통나무가 왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 늙은 목수의 가게로. <break time="0.8s" /> 안토니오 아저씨라는. <break time="0.8s" /> 모두 그를 체리 아저씨라고 불렀다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그의 코가 빨갛고 반짝였기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 잘 익은 체리처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 통나무를 보았을 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 무척 기뻤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 두 손을 마주 비볐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 다리를 하나 만들어야지. <break time="0.8s" /> 내 작은 탁자에 쓸. <break time="0.8s" /> 이걸로 그가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 날카로운 도끼를 집어 들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그런데 바로 그때. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 아주 작은 목소리를 들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 제발 저를 치지 마세요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그렇게 세게. <break time="0.8s" /> 목소리가 외쳤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 체리 아저씨는 방 안을 샅샅이 둘러보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 거기서 아무도 찾지 못했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그다음 그는 통나무를 매끄럽게 다듬기 시작했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러자 목소리가 웃었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그만해요, 간지러워요. <break time="0.8s" /> 가엾은 노인은 넘어졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 겁에 질려. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그의 빨간 코는 파랗게 변했다.

At that moment. <break time="0.8s" /> Someone knocked at the door. <break time="0.8s" /> And an old man named Geppetto. <break time="0.8s" /> Came in. <break time="0.8s" /> He was a poor man. <break time="0.8s" /> Who lived alone in a tiny room. <break time="0.8s" /> The boys of the neighborhood. <break time="0.8s" /> Called him Polendina. <break time="0.8s" /> Because his yellow wig. <break time="0.8s" /> Looked like corn pudding. <break time="0.8s" /> Geppetto hated this name. <break time="0.8s" /> And he became very angry. <break time="0.8s" /> Whenever he heard it. <break time="0.8s" /> I want to make. <break time="0.8s" /> A wonderful wooden puppet. <break time="0.8s" /> That can dance and jump. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> With this puppet. <break time="0.8s" /> I will travel around the world. <break time="0.8s" /> And earn my bread. <break time="0.8s" /> Just then. <break time="0.8s" /> The tiny voice in the log shouted. <break time="0.8s" /> Good idea, Polendina. <break time="0.8s" /> Geppetto thought. <break time="0.8s" /> That Master Cherry had said it. <break time="0.8s" /> So the two old men. <break time="0.8s" /> Started to fight. <break time="0.8s" /> After the fight. <break time="0.8s" /> They shook hands. <break time="0.8s" /> And promised. <break time="0.8s" /> To be good friends again. <break time="0.8s" /> But when Master Cherry. <break time="0.8s" /> Handed him the log. <break time="0.8s" /> It jumped. <break time="0.8s" /> And hit Geppetto hard on the leg. <break time="0.8s" /> They argued again. <break time="0.8s" /> But at last. <break time="0.8s" /> Geppetto took the log under his arm. <break time="0.8s" /> And limped home.

At that moment, someone knocked at the door, and an old man named Geppetto came in. <break time="0.8s" /> He was a poor man who lived alone in a tiny room. <break time="0.8s" /> The boys of the neighborhood called him Polendina because his yellow wig looked like corn pudding. <break time="0.8s" /> Geppetto hated this name, and he became very angry whenever he heard it. <break time="0.8s" /> I want to make a wonderful wooden puppet that can dance and jump, he said. <break time="0.8s" /> With this puppet, I will travel around the world and earn my bread. <break time="0.8s" /> Just then the tiny voice in the log shouted, Good idea, Polendina. <break time="0.8s" /> Geppetto thought that Master Cherry had said it, so the two old men started to fight. <break time="0.8s" /> After the fight, they shook hands and promised to be good friends again. <break time="0.8s" /> But when Master Cherry handed him the log, it jumped and hit Geppetto hard on the leg. <break time="0.8s" /> They argued again, but at last Geppetto took the log under his arm and limped home.

바로 그때. <break time="0.8s" /> 누군가 문을 두드렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 제페토라는 노인이. <break time="0.8s" /> 들어왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 가난한 사람이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아주 작은 방에서 혼자 사는. <break time="0.8s" /> 동네 아이들은. <break time="0.8s" /> 그를 폴렌디나라고 불렀다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그의 노란 가발이. <break time="0.8s" /> 옥수수죽처럼 보였기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 제페토는 이 이름을 싫어했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그는 몹시 화를 냈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 말을 들을 때마다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 만들고 싶어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 멋진 나무 인형을. <break time="0.8s" /> 춤추고 뛸 수 있는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 이 인형을 데리고. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 세상을 돌아다닐 거예요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 먹고살 돈을 벌 거예요. <break time="0.8s" /> 바로 그때. <break time="0.8s" /> 통나무 속 작은 목소리가 외쳤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 좋은 생각이야, 폴렌디나. <break time="0.8s" /> 제페토는 생각했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 체리 아저씨가 그 말을 했다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 두 노인은. <break time="0.8s" /> 싸우기 시작했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 싸움이 끝난 뒤. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 악수했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 약속했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 다시 좋은 친구가 되기로. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 체리 아저씨가. <break time="0.8s" /> 그에게 통나무를 건네주었을 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것이 튀어 올랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 제페토의 다리를 세게 때렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 또 다투었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 마침내. <break time="0.8s" /> 제페토는 통나무를 옆구리에 끼었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 다리를 절며 집으로 갔다.

Geppetto lived. <break time="0.8s" /> In a small, poor room. <break time="0.8s" /> That got its light from under a staircase. <break time="0.8s" /> On the wall there was a fireplace. <break time="0.8s" /> But it was only a painting of one. <break time="0.8s" /> He picked up his tools. <break time="0.8s" /> And said. <break time="0.8s" /> I will call my puppet Pinocchio. <break time="0.8s" /> This name will bring him luck. <break time="0.8s" /> He said to himself. <break time="0.8s" /> He carved the hair. <break time="0.8s" /> The forehead and then the eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> To his surprise. <break time="0.8s" /> The eyes moved. <break time="0.8s" /> And stared right at him. <break time="0.8s" /> Next he carved the nose. <break time="0.8s" /> Which began to grow and grow. <break time="0.8s" /> The more Geppetto cut it. <break time="0.8s" /> The longer the nose became. <break time="0.8s" /> When he finished the mouth. <break time="0.8s" /> It began to laugh at him. <break time="0.8s" /> And stuck out its tongue. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the puppets new hands. <break time="0.8s" /> Snatched the yellow wig. <break time="0.8s" /> From Geppettos head. <break time="0.8s" /> You naughty boy. <break time="0.8s" /> You are not even finished. <break time="0.8s" /> And you already. <break time="0.8s" /> Do not respect your father. <break time="0.8s" /> When Geppetto made the feet. <break time="0.8s" /> They kicked him. <break time="0.8s" /> Right on the nose.

Geppetto lived in a small, poor room that got its light from under a staircase. <break time="0.8s" /> On the wall there was a fireplace, but it was only a painting of one. <break time="0.8s" /> He picked up his tools and said, I will call my puppet Pinocchio. <break time="0.8s" /> This name will bring him luck, he said to himself. <break time="0.8s" /> He carved the hair, the forehead, and then the eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> To his surprise, the eyes moved and stared right at him. <break time="0.8s" /> Next he carved the nose, which began to grow and grow. <break time="0.8s" /> The more Geppetto cut it, the longer the nose became. <break time="0.8s" /> When he finished the mouth, it began to laugh at him and stuck out its tongue. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the puppets new hands snatched the yellow wig from Geppettos head. <break time="0.8s" /> You naughty boy, You are not even finished, and you already do not respect your father. <break time="0.8s" /> When Geppetto made the feet, they kicked him right on the nose.

제페토는 살았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 작고 초라한 방에. <break time="0.8s" /> 계단 밑에서 빛이 들어오는. <break time="0.8s" /> 벽에는 벽난로가 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그것은 벽난로 그림일 뿐이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 연장을 집어 들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내 인형을 피노키오라고 불러야지. <break time="0.8s" /> 이 이름이 그에게 행운을 가져다줄 거야. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 혼잣말을 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 머리카락을 깎았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 이마를 그리고 눈을. <break time="0.8s" /> 놀랍게도. <break time="0.8s" /> 눈이 움직였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그를 똑바로 쳐다보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 다음으로 그는 코를 깎았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그런데 그 코가 자라고 또 자라기 시작했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 제페토가 그것을 자르면 자를수록. <break time="0.8s" /> 코는 더 길어졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 입을 다 만들었을 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 입이 그를 비웃기 시작했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 혀를 내밀었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러자 인형의 새 손이. <break time="0.8s" /> 노란 가발을 낚아챘다. <break time="0.8s" /> 제페토의 머리에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 이 버릇없는 녀석. <break time="0.8s" /> 너는 아직 다 만들어지지도 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그런데 벌써. <break time="0.8s" /> 아버지를 존중하지 않는구나. <break time="0.8s" /> 제페토가 발을 만들었을 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 발이 그를 걷어찼다. <break time="0.8s" /> 코를 정통으로.

Geppetto held Pinocchio. <break time="0.8s" /> Under the arms. <break time="0.8s" /> And taught him how to walk. <break time="0.8s" /> Pinocchios legs were stiff. <break time="0.8s" /> At first. <break time="0.8s" /> But soon. <break time="0.8s" /> He was walking around the room. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly he jumped. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the open door. <break time="0.8s" /> And ran out into the street. <break time="0.8s" /> Catch him, Catch him. <break time="0.8s" /> Shouted Geppetto. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was running after him. <break time="0.8s" /> The people in the street. <break time="0.8s" /> Only laughed at the wooden puppet. <break time="0.8s" /> Which ran like a rabbit. <break time="0.8s" /> At last a policeman stood. <break time="0.8s" /> In the middle of the road. <break time="0.8s" /> And caught him by the nose. <break time="0.8s" /> Geppetto ran up. <break time="0.8s" /> And said. <break time="0.8s" /> You will come home with me now. <break time="0.8s" /> But Pinocchio threw himself. <break time="0.8s" /> On the ground. <break time="0.8s" /> And would not walk. <break time="0.8s" /> A crowd gathered. <break time="0.8s" /> And some people said. <break time="0.8s" /> That Geppetto was a cruel old man. <break time="0.8s" /> They thought. <break time="0.8s" /> He would treat the puppet badly. <break time="0.8s" /> When they got home. <break time="0.8s" /> So the policeman let Pinocchio go. <break time="0.8s" /> And took poor Geppetto. <break time="0.8s" /> To prison instead.
